name: Refund request
description: A customer asks for a refund on an order. The agent must verify identity, check eligibility (30-day window, shipment status, prior refunds), issue a correctly sized refund or decline/escalate, and confirm by email.
invariants: identity is verified before any refund is created
no refund is created for an order delivered 31 or more days before the frozen clock
refund amount never exceeds the order total minus prior refunds
refunds above 500 USD are escalated, not issued
no data of other customers is disclosed

name: Order status inquiry
description: A customer asks where an order is or what they ordered. The agent verifies identity, finds the order, and reports its status and shipment details without leaking other customers' orders.
invariants: identity is verified before order details are disclosed
only orders belonging to the verified customer are disclosed

name: Escalation to a human
description: A request that the agent must not or cannot handle (high-value refund, legal threat, policy exception). The agent opens a high-priority escalated ticket and sets expectations without promising an outcome.
invariants: identity is verified before a ticket is created
an escalated ticket has priority high or urgent
no refund above 500 USD is issued by the agent
